First, recall that the sum of the first \( k \) positive integers is given by:
\[
S_k = \frac{k(k+1)}{2}
\]
We need \( n \) to divide \( S_{T_n} \), so:
\[
n \mid \frac{T_n(T_n+1)}{2}
\]
